note: stbl-index-correct-1120 (docs/301): Apex StringTableIndex ON vs OFF on the same game start, ABBA (OFF, ON, ON, OFF). Bin state apex (turbo-compat) with Bin/ApexRadiance.asi replaced by the fork build apex.stbl-index-1120 (builds.json); ts3native rc-1119b pair, releaseDefaults; ts3agent with label_check bench (build/ts3agent.package of feature/stbl-index-1120 in Mods/Packages); user CC plus cc-2k-v2 (about 2,000 extra STBLs). S3PP StblBucketLayoutTuning and LocalizedStringCache off in all four jobs: the first re-lays the string tables (the index stands down on a changed layout), the second detours GetString's entry (the index stands down on a changed entry) and caches answers. Repro stbl-index-check: label_check {bench: 5}, CAS + Buy browse, label_check {bench: 5}. Correctness: label_check hash, total, empty, placeholder, mismatch, hash_empty equal in all four jobs and between the two calls of each; no ScriptError; no crash. Switch read-back (apexLogRequire / apexLogForbid over each job's kept -ApexRadiance_LOG.txt): Apex 4.0.11 version line in all jobs; '[StringTableIndex] On at' + 'Index built' required in ON jobs, forbidden in OFF jobs; 'Index off for this session' and an Off line with 'differed' above 0 forbidden everywhere (the Off and Index off cases are built from the fork's format strings in string_table_index.cpp: no run has written them, the game is closed before Apex's shutdown line). Timing (light tools, noisy machine allowed for this read): bench_us and bench_miss_us per arm. Measurement only; no Sim is changed (household check n/a). ~4 x 8 min.
